cases.question: What is PaymentOps Workbench?
cases.answer: PaymentOps Workbench is a personal project Nitin designed and built independently in 2026. It is a local-first, synthetic-data-only workbench for investigating payment exceptions and evaluating AI-assisted review behavior before promotion [project-paymentops#1]. It uses Python, Java and TypeScript across three services: React, Spring Boot and FastAPI [project-paymentops#1]. Its design starts with deterministic facts, such as timelines, flags and citations, before any AI behavior [project-paymentops#6].
